It's also a tell that memory makers are re-allocating capacity toward AI-linked demand, tightening supply for everyone else. 影响: 如此大幅的涨价意味着内存已经成为 AI 硬件供应链的瓶颈，而不仅仅是 GPU 短缺。DRAM 成本上升会挤压超大规模厂商的利润，也提高了 AI capex 回本的门槛。这也说明内存厂商正把产能向 AI 相关需求倾斜，从而收紧了其他领域的供应。

Hard drive prices change three times a day; structural growth in the storage industry may still have further to run.  Moomoo ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: A Moomoo news item reports severe hard-drive (storage) supply shortages, with prices reportedly changing three times a day, and flags 'structural growth' in the storage industry as still having further to run. 内容: Moomoo 的一篇新闻报道称硬盘（存储）供应严重短缺，价格据称一天变动三次，并指出存储行业的'结构性增长'可能仍有上行空间。 Why it matters: Storage/memory scarcity (HDD/NAND/DRAM/HBM) feeds directly into AI server bill-of-materials cost and lead times — a shortage this acute signals demand is outrunning supply chain capacity, which can either validate the AI-capex buildout (real demand) or amplify bubble-stress if hyperscalers are forced to overpay/stockpile ahead of need. 影响: 存储/内存（HDD/NAND/DRAM/HBM）的紧缺直接影响 AI 服务器的物料成本和交付周期——如此严重的短缺意味着需求正在超过供应链的承载能力，这既可能印证 AI capex 建设的真实需求，也可能加剧泡沫压力，因为超大规模厂商可能被迫提前囤货或高价采购。

alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22DRAM%22+price+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Sun, 05 Jul 2026 21:00:00 GMT Link: https://news.google.?oc=5 AI-driven DRAM shortage curbs China dumping as CXMT climbs to No. 4 - CHOSUNBIZ - Chosunbiz AI-driven DRAM shortage curbs China dumping as CXMT climbs to No. 4 - CHOSUNBIZ  Chosunbiz ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: A DRAM shortage driven by AI demand is curbing Chinese memory dumping, letting Chinese maker CXMT climb to the No. 4 spot in the DRAM market. 内容: 受 AI 需求驱动的 DRAM 短缺正在抑制中国厂商的低价倾销，中国存储厂商 CXMT 借此跻身 DRAM 市场第四位。 Why it matters: Tight memory supply raises input costs across the AI hardware stack (HBM/DRAM feed GPUs and servers) and signals demand is outrunning capacity — but a rising Chinese competitor also points to future oversupply risk once CXMT scales further. 影响: 内存供给吃紧会推高整个 AI 硬件链条（HBM/DRAM 供应 GPU 与服务器）的成本，说明需求正在跑赢产能；但中国厂商份额上升，也预示 CXMT 产能进一步爬坡后可能带来未来的供过于求风险。
